field.label: Enable Pancake order export
field.comment: When Yes, Magento-origin orders are pushed to Pancake POS after place, if Fulfillment Core outbound export is also Yes. Leave No until Shop ID, API Key, and at least one active warehouse map exist (Secomm → Pancake POS → Warehouse Mapping). Default: No. Does not import orders created only inside Pancake.

field.label: Enable log
field.comment: When Yes, FulfillmentCore writes Pancake logs to var/log/fulfillment/pancake/fulfillment.log. Other POS modules have their own flag and folder. Default: No. Does not log api_key or phone numbers.

field.label: Base URL
field.comment: Pancake POS Open API root. Default and expected value: https://pos.pages.fm/api/v1. Do not use the Pancake Chat/Inbox API. Change only if ops routes calls through a proxy. Used as the prefix for POST /shops/{Shop ID}/orders and GET warehouses.

field.label: Shop ID
field.comment: Numeric Pancake shop id. Get it from the Pancake POS admin URL after you open the shop: the number immediately after /shop/ (example: https://pos.pages.fm/shop/6036602/...). Or call GET {Base URL}/shops?api_key=... and use the shop "id". This value is the {SHOP_ID} path segment. Not the Facebook Page ID.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: Create or copy it in Pancake POS: Settings (Cấu hình) → Application configuration (Cấu hình ứng dụng) / Advanced → Third-party connection → Webhook/API → API Key → Add new. The key must be enabled (Bật) on Pancake. Magento stores it encrypted and sends it only as the api_key query parameter. Never commit this value or paste it into tickets.

field.label: Webhook secret
field.comment: A random string you invent in Magento (Pancake Open API does not issue this secret). Then configure the caller to POST the storefront URL https://<store>/pancake/webhook/index?secret=<this value>. Empty disables the check — do not leave empty on a public store. Optional: status can also arrive via Poll below without a webhook.

field.label: Poll Magento-origin POS orders
field.comment: When Yes, cron secomm_pancake_poll_orders (every 15 minutes) calls GET /shops/{Shop ID}/orders/{external id} only for rows already exported from Magento (push_status success). It does not pull orders created only in Pancake. Requires Enable + Shop ID + API Key. Up to 40 mapped orders per run. Default: Yes. Independent of the webhook secret.
